integrity: The proof contains a universal gap-truncation argument and finite exact-type certificate; computational checks do not substitute for the universal lemma.
scientific_limitations: Only nonempty finite point-pair separation circles in the equality and one quaternary separation signature; rank five only. Possible unindexed historical overlap. Full text of the 2005 circular-minimality paper unavailable, but its abstract concerns an infinite, differently signed setting. No independent audit.
title: Fifteen rank-five theories of finite circular point-pair separation structures
